//: Hook wiring for a stamped project. Each command uses ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}, which Claude Code resolves to this folder, so moving or re-cloning it needs no re-wire for Claude. Codex gets its own copy with absolute paths in .codex/hooks.json from bootstrap.sh --harness; after a move, re-run that and re-approve the hooks in Codex's /hooks review. Merge into any existing settings rather than clobbering.
